name: Code blocks
description: Syntax highlighting in fenced code blocks (```python, ```js, and over a hundred more), each language loaded the first time a block uses it. A block reads as a card with its language, Wrap and Copy (⌘⇧C copies the block the cursor is in); click into it to edit, and its fences show.

editor.why: Highlight code in notes, and add each block's Copy and Wrap

code-blocks.wrap.description: Wrap long lines in code blocks, as the rest of the note wraps. Wrap on a block changes it for that block while the note is open.

commands.title: Copy the code block the cursor is in
